question: ‘Ujjwala’, a ______, was the official mascot of Khelo India – Para Games 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sparrow**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ujjwala** was the official mascot of Khelo India – Para Games 2023.
 
• Ujjwala is depicted as a **sparrow**.
 
• The choice of a sparrow as a mascot represents vitality, energy, and resilience, aligning with the spirit of the Para Games.
 
• The Khelo India – Para Games is an initiative to promote sports among differently-abled athletes and provide them with a platform to showcase their talents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India** is a national program aimed at the development of sports in India, launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It includes various initiatives to identify and nurture young talent, enhance sports infrastructure, and promote a strong sports culture in the country.
 
• The Khelo India – Para Games are a part of this broader initiative, focusing specifically on athletes with disabilities.
 
• The event features a wide range of sports, ensuring inclusivity and equal opportunities for all participants.
